Account.description: A ledger account holding a balance. Lifecycle open↔frozen→closed (Decision 7); carries lock_type and dormancy state.

AccountNumber.description: A routing/account-number pair issued against an Account — 1:Many (Decision 2). Used for FBO attribution and external addressing (Decision 20).

AchTransfer.description: An ACH credit or debit transfer. Lifecycle pending_approval→submitted→settled, with return/rejection handling.

BsaAlert.description: A Bank Secrecy Act transaction-monitoring alert.

Card.description: A payment card issued against an account.

CardAuthorization.description: A card authorization request and its decision.

columns.name: evidence
columns.note: array of Document (soft ref by id -> document)

ControlResult.description: The recorded result of a control execution.

Entity.description: A legal person or organization (person, business, trust, or joint) that owns accounts.

FboPosition.description: For-Benefit-Of position and balance for an aggregator instance (Decision 19).

Filing.description: A regulatory filing and its lifecycle (submit→acknowledge).

InboundPayment.description: An inbound payment routed to an instance.

Incident.description: An operational or security incident and its response.

LegalHold.description: A legal hold on records, with release handling.

Loan.description: A booked loan on the ledger.

columns.name: status
columns.note: synthesized from x-states (no status property in spec)

LoanApplication.description: A credit application and its decisioning.

columns.name: status
columns.note: synthesized from x-states (no status property in spec)

Originator.description: The sending party of a transfer.

ProviderResult.description: A result returned by an external provider or vendor.

Task.description: A unit of compliance or operational work. `type` is the generic verb; `subject` carries the domain.

Transfer.description: An on-us book transfer between internal accounts (Decision 8). External rails use AchTransfer / WireTransfer.

User.description: An operator or staff user of the system.

WireTransfer.description: A domestic wire transfer. Lifecycle pending_approval→submitted→completed, with return-request handling.

change.description: A change request tracked through review, deployment, and post-implementation review.

coi.description: A conflict-of-interest disclosure tracked from disclosure through review to determination.

complaint.description: A consumer or member complaint tracked from intake through investigation and resolution.

dispute.description: A Regulation E error/dispute tracked from filing through investigation to resolution.

finding.description: An audit, examination, or compliance finding tracked through its remediation lifecycle.

handover.description: A trustee/fiduciary handover tracked from initiation through provisioning to completion.

indemnification.description: An indemnification request tracked from filing through determination to payment.

insider.description: A Regulation O insider-credit request tracked through board review to approval or denial.

records_package.description: A records-production package tracked from request through assembly to completion.

risk.description: A risk-register entry tracked through assessment into ongoing monitoring (remediation is a sub-process).

trade.description: An investment trade tracked from entry through confirmation to settlement.

training.description: A training assignment tracked from assignment through completion, with lapse on overdue cycles.
